claim: A standard On-Loan adult Octopus card costs HK$150 (HK$50 refundable deposit plus HK$100 starting stored value); the Sold Tourist Octopus is HK$39 with no stored value.

claim: The Airport Express single fare from the airport to Hong Kong Station is HK$130 (HK$115 to Kowloon Station) and the ride to Hong Kong Station takes about 24 minutes.

claim: Octopus holders can ride the Airport Express from Kowloon or Tsing Yi to Hong Kong Station for only HK$25 during the Morning Express Service window.

claim: Hong Kong Tramways ('ding ding') charges a flat fare regardless of distance: HK$3.30 adult, HK$1.60 child under 12, HK$1.50 senior, effective from 12 May 2025.

claim: The Peak Tram costs roughly HK$76 single / HK$108 return for adults (tram only), separate from the historic ding ding street trams.
quote: A single ticket for adults costs HK$76, while a return fare costs HK$108.

claim: Tuen Ng (Dragon Boat) Festival is a public holiday on Friday 19 June 2026, and Hong Kong marks its 50th-anniversary dragon boat year with its biggest-ever 13-day waterfront festival running June 19 to July 1, 2026.
quote: 2026 Sun Life Hong Kong International Dragon Boat Festival ... waterfront program extended to 13 days for the first time, running from June 19 to July 1

claim: The marquee Sun Life Hong Kong International Dragon Boat Races run June 27-28 2026 at the Tsim Sha Tsui Promenade with 220+ teams from 16 countries in 21 races; smaller local races also occur at Stanley, Aberdeen, Sai Kung, Sha Tin, Cheung Chau, Discovery Bay and Tai O.
quote: races will take place from June 27 to 28 at the Tsim Sha Tsui Promenade ... more than 220 teams from 16 countries and regions competing in 21 races

claim: June in Hong Kong is hot and very humid: daytime highs around 30-32C (mid-80s to low-90s F), nights near 26C, humidity averaging 86-90%, roughly 19 rainy days and ~366mm rainfall, with typhoon season beginning.
quote: daytime temperatures usually reach 30C ... 19 days with some rain ... average monthly rainfall is 366mm
note: humidity 86-90% and ~1.4 storm-affected days per June corroborated across multiple June-weather sources

claim: The Hong Kong Observatory seasonal outlook for June-August 2026 forecasts above-normal temperatures and normal to below-normal rainfall, and typhoon season runs roughly June through September.
quote: Seasonal Forecast for June-August 2026 ... above-normal temperature and normal to below-normal rainfall

claim: Tsim Sha Tsui (TST) is the top first-timer base for harbour views and the nightly Symphony of Lights but can feel touristy; Central offers polished convenience with fast airport links and SoHo/Lan Kwai Fong nightlife but is pricier; Causeway Bay is shopping- and food-dense with Victoria Park and a more local, relaxed vibe.
quote: Tsim Sha Tsui remains Hong Kong's most popular area for first-time visitors ... Central provides polished convenience ... Causeway Bay ... plenty of places to eat and shop and it had a relaxed vibe
